summary: Iteration 10 testing of org edit + user profile/password features. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_profile_org.py (16 tests) covering PATCH /api/orgs/{id}, PATCH /api/auth/me, POST /api/auth/change-password incl. RBAC, validation, persistence, and login-after-change; 15/16 pass. Full backend regression suite re-run: 139 passed / 3 failed (2 are pre-existing seed-data drift). Frontend: admin + member Playwright flows for Workspace settings dialog and Profile page (both tabs, validations) all pass, plus regression of nav, task list/board, search filter, timer start/stop, comments, burndown.

minor.issue: Non-existent org id returns 403 'Not a member of this organization' instead of the specified 404 (membership lookup precedes existence check). Defensible ACL-first design, but deviates from the stated spec — decide and align (spec or test).

Null values are stripped (updates = {k: v for ... if v is not None}), so a user can never CLEAR their avatar / workspace logo. Frontend sends `picture: picture || null` and `logo: logo || null`, so blanking the field silently keeps the old value. Send "" from FE or allow explicit nulls in BE.

ui_bugs.issue: Workspace `logo` can be saved via org-logo-input but is never rendered anywhere — sidebar always shows the first letter of the org name. The field is effectively dead data.

issues: Start date / Due date use native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar component
No issues found: layout, contrast, spacing fine; email field visibly disabled with helper text

action_items: Allow clearing avatar/logo (accept empty string or explicit null) — currently impossible.
Render org logo in the sidebar/org switcher (or drop the field) since it is saved but never displayed.

Pre-existing data drift: seeded admin's project_role on 'Web Redesign' is 'member' not 'lead' (test_project_members.py::test_list_members_shape_includes_admin_as_lead fails). Either re-run the idempotent lead backfill or relax the test.
Optional: replace native date inputs in TaskDialog with shadcn calendar.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_org / update_profile: `if v is not None` filter blocks intentional clears; consider `body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` instead.
server.py is 1215 lines — consider splitting routers (auth, orgs, tasks, analytics) into modules.

PasswordChange enforces min_length=6 at the Pydantic layer, so bad input returns 422 (not 400); frontend already pre-validates so UX is fine, but the API contract in the request said 400 — worth documenting.
Change-password does not rotate/invalidate the existing JWT or other sessions after a password change; old tokens stay valid until expiry.
